entries.title: Revocable expert grants and exact reviewed client projections
entries.summary: Opt-in B03-03 collaboration components with current injected authority, exact matter/object/source scope, independent disclosure review and a client-only content allowlist; no shared-router or production portal activation.
added: Transactional immutable specialist/client grants, expiry, durable revocation, audit and explicit-object expert reads; separately authored projection drafts, exact recipient/grant/content review, terminal withdrawal and client allowlisted reads.
Mandatory policy/case/source adapters, concrete agreed VaultSources transaction-gate wrapper, agency-only route registration and separate internal/client CSP-safe browser mounts.
37 controlled SQLite/API regressions plus precise central wiring/migration/security instructions and complete ER-01..15 lane receipt.
changed: No shared application/router/navigation/dependency/acceptance or canonical tracking edits; original alpha import/audit and local app remain untouched.
verification: 37 focused collaboration/projection/API tests passed (one dependency warning); 35 pre-existing authority/access tests passed; Python compilation and all 19 JavaScript modules passed syntax checks.

Initial full pytest without nvm Node PATH: 96 failed, 1296 passed; corrected PATH yielded 1392 passed on the pre-anti-enumeration checkpoint. Final independent native run pending at this checkpoint; failures retained in lane receipt.
limitations: Local unreleased component checkpoint, not B03-03 acceptance. Actual request-bound identity/case/vault integration, exact agency route mappings, body/error middleware and navigation remain integrator-owned.
No native new-flow usability review, production tenant infrastructure, independent human disclosure/security acceptance, secure portal, inference, external send, recall, merge or deployment claim.

discoveries: Disclosure review binds recipient and immutable grant as well as content; safe metadata is not commit authorization; client lifecycle checks must not grant internal source access; exact review/refresh burden needs measurement.
risks: Malicious/missing host adapters, broad client route aliases, source readiness races, semantic leakage in curated text and overclaiming component/native evidence.
architecture_implications: Use the same active SQLite write transaction for current authority, source policy and disclosure/audit mutation; retain explicit capability roles and client allowlist with no local bearer fallback.
emergence_review.roadmap_decision: Existing-task B03-03 refinements only; EM-176 remains a candidate. No new required scope or global acceptance promotion.
